definitions.explanation: Payment that has not yet been made, especially one that is due. Used for bills, wages, taxes, and other financial obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{未払|みばら}いになっている。
{未払|みばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未払|みばら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{延滞|えんたい}→延滞：09003_entai⟧{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}します→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: If unpaid taxes continue, late fees will accrue.

notes:
The ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ prefix means "not yet," indicating something that should have been done but hasn't.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未払|みばら}い{金|きん}: outstanding payment amount
- {未払|みばら}い⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: unpaid balance
- ⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧{未払|みばら}い: unpaid wages
- {未払|みばら}い⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: the unpaid portion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧: delinquent payment — implies willful neglect or prolonged failure to pay, stronger than {未払|みばら}い
- ⟦{未納|みのう}→未納：19001_minou⟧: also means unpaid, but more commonly used for taxes and public fees

OTHER {未|み} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧: undecided
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: unfinished
- ⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧: inexperienced
